claims.text: Veeam Agent for Unix supports pre-job/post-job scripts, e.g. to quiesce an application [1]
Veeam Agent for Linux supports pre/post-job scripts on agent computer and backup server, plus pre-freeze/post-thaw [2][3]
Veeam Agent for Windows supports pre-freeze/post-thaw on agent and pre/post-job on backup server [4]
VBR runs scripts on backup server before/after job via Scripts tab in advanced settings [5][6][8][9][10]
MABS supports pre/post-backup scripts per data source in ScriptingConfig.xml on protected computer [7]
Pre-freeze/post-thaw (Guest Processing) are for quiescence; advanced-settings scripts relate to the job itself [5][6][8][9][10]

A.notes: All claims supported. Linux item omits the 10-minute timeout/Server edition; MABS omits local system account; silent on AWS and Cohesity.

claims.text: VBR can run custom scripts before job start and after completion [1][2]
VBR script settings for backup jobs with before/after options [7]
VBR provides pre-freeze/post-thaw scripts for application-aware processing [9]
VBR custom pre-freeze/post-thaw for VMs with non-VSS apps [13][4]
For Linux VMs VBR runs custom scripts before/after snapshot to quiesce apps [6]
Guest scripting runs pre/post-snapshot scripts on EC2 instances [11][12]
'Run scripts every backup session' option runs scripts before/after every policy session [8]
Veeam Agent backup job scripts run pre-job/post-job scripts [3]
Veeam Agent for Windows pre-freeze/post-thaw to quiesce OS for non-VSS apps [14]
VSPC: Veeam backup agent supports pre-freeze/post-thaw scripts [5]
MABS runs pre-backup scripts before and post-backup scripts after a protection job [10]
MABS runs scripts under local system account, checks ScriptingConfig.xml on protected computer [15]

B.notes: Claims supported (EC2 guest scripting is a backup appliance feature filed under VBR). No Veeam Agent for Linux; MABS lacks per-data-source detail; silent on AWS and Cohesity.

claims.text: Microsoft 365 Backup is pay-as-you-go, charged on consumption, not user-based licences [2]
Billing set up via Azure subscription, resource group, region, owner/contributor role [6]
Departmental billing via multiple billing policies / Azure subscriptions [6][8]
VB365 licensed per user account, one licence unit each; restores need no licence [1]
Units consumed by mailboxes, OneDrive, SharePoint personal sites backed up within last 31 days [1]
Subscription licence paid, 1-5 year term [1][4]
Rental licence ~1 month, service providers only [1][3]
NFR and Evaluation free licences [1]
No licence = Community Edition: 10 users, 1 TB SharePoint, 10 teams [1][5]

A.notes: All supported; misses automatic revocation after 31 days and that Teams/group sites consume no units.

Active Backup Storage Controller responsible for billing in Consuming Tenant [12][13]

Cost breakdowns for OneDrive, Exchange, SharePoint [2][3][4]

Get-MailboxStatistics estimates online archive sizes [8]
VB365 licensed per user account, one licence unit each [16]
Users with access to backed-up teams / non-personal SharePoint sites must be licensed [21]
Subscription and Rental types; auto-update + usage reporting doubles allowed overage [20][22]
Rental licence for service providers, ~1 month [17]
